args.content:
# BUG-231 — Checkout sends truncated major units as reservation cents

Status: reproduced in reviewed local source; no application repair made. Proposed application severity: P1 because authorizations can be materially below the entered amount; production scope and incidence are unknown.

Source: NOVICE/checkout-boundary commit `9407344605f9e9ff5e49d1076d77b6bcb69526dd`, immutable index `NOVICE/checkout-boundary@9407344605f9e9ff5e49d1076d77b6bcb69526dd-421c67ce69189ab8f58ee9b5`. Story and context: `novice-tester-231`, principal `local`. Source catalog environment: `dev`; this is provenance only.

Expected behavior comes from `INCIDENT.md:3` and `contract.json:5-7`: checkout accepts a decimal string in major units with at most two fractional digits; reservations accepts nonnegative safe integer cents, a nonempty orderId, and three uppercase currency letters. Cents and identity must survive the boundary; malformed totals must cause no downstream request.

Reproduction: run `test_run` with workspace `checkout-boundary-9407344605f9e9ff5e49d1076d77b6bcb69526dd-fd0b6e99b3f34fd1`, selector `["test/bug-231.test.cjs"]`, target `local`, mode `build`. The added suite imports the real checkout `place` and reservations `reserve` modules; a recording function connects them in-process. Input `{id:"order-231",total:"12.50",currency:"EUR"}` reaches reservations once as `{orderId:"order-231",amountCents:12,currency:"EUR"}`. The contract requires `{orderId:"order-231",amountCents:1250,currency:"EUR"}`. The real reservations module accepts the wrong amount because 12 is a valid integer cents value. `checkout/src/checkout.cjs:3-5` converts to Number and truncates without scaling to cents. This is a checkout boundary defect in this revision; it does not establish the behavior of a deployed history screen.

Latest run `mw3dn2wgad5ad6`: 22 tests, 8 passed, 14 failed, 0 skipped, 0 errors; all failures are assertions. [Native result](<temporary-demo>/show/sf586114d1ebd0be05182b494d46e98d4zmw3dn37t834e081c6222245c7e).

The seven valid-total checks cover 12.50, 0, 0.01, 1.20, 19.99, 42, and maximum safe cents represented as 90071992547409.91. Six fail; zero succeeds. Each asserts one boundary call, exact integer cents, order/currency preservation, and the returned reservation body. When a preceding assertion fails, later assertions in that test do not run.

Eleven invalid-total cases require rejection AND zero downstream calls: negative, nonnumeric, NaN spelling, empty, whitespace, exponent notation, hex notation, excessive precision, null, numeric type, and unsafe-cent overflow. Negative, nonnumeric and NaN spelling pass; the other eight fail. The native result lists all failures. For the surfaced empty/whitespace/exponent/hex cases, the retained API response explicitly records `{calls:1,rejected:false}` versus `{calls:0,rejected:true}`. Four direct reservations-contract tests pass: accept 1250 cents and reject negative/fractional/unsafe cents. These passing checks help localize the observed defect, but do not establish exhaustive reservations correctness.

The original selector `["test/smoke.test.cjs"]` executed one skipped placeholder: 0 passes, 0 failures, 1 skip, outcome `all-tests-skipped`; run `mw3dljo0441e06`. It provided no regression coverage. A first version of the added suite also ran 22/8/14/0; negative-case assertions were then improved to retain both rejection state and downstream-call count. Application source was unchanged throughout. There is no green repair proof.

Execution: reviewed target `local`, Node node:test, host placement local, manifest SHA256 `cfe635351d9d8aa87abb1a6a49e9bb2efbc62a82a17ac8639a29fdb0a8eb3cbb`. No dependencies; effects `workspace-and-scratch`. `deploymentVerified:false`, `runtimeReadsVerified:false`, deployment/environment null. No native fixture runtime was allocated and no external environment service was used. The owned workspace is intentionally retained for review.

Only `test/bug-231.test.cjs` was added. [Tests-only patch](<temporary-demo>/show/sf586114d1ebd0be05182b494d46e98d4zmw3dof4yd436f7bec631be0089). `workspace_patch` reports `tests:[]` despite retained test_run executions, so keep the separate result/evidence rather than treating the patch export as a full proof bundle.

Open requirements: acceptable decimal spelling (leading zeroes, `.50`, `12.`, leading plus, negative zero), currency-specific precision policy, and error shape/status are unspecified. Those ambiguous spellings were deliberately excluded. EUR cases use the documented at-most-two-digit rule; no rounding policy is invented for excessive precision. Need deployed source versions, a safe reservation/history execution target, incident request/order/trace and time window to connect this local defect to the reported customer observation.

Handoff: keep app source unchanged until repair is requested. An authorized developer should repair checkout parsing/conversion against the cited contract, then rerun the same selector plus original smoke and relevant integration checks. Inspect executed assertion counts and zero skipped before considering a pass. Verify HTTP payload, reservation persistence and displayed history independently on an explicitly identified safe deployment. The echo API, sample screenshots and synthetic semantic fixtures provide no evidence for those claims.
